equal_postpeak_age_correlation.interpretation: Retrospective observed-peak alignment. Level correlation can reflect common nonstationary decline; does not establish return predictability. Earlier weekly/calendar correlation is a different transform/frequency/alignment and cannot be called a quantitative improvement.

candidate_matching_audit.recomputed_from: all_candidates.csv feature values only, not saved distance or matching columns
candidate_matching_audit.strict_base_zero_interpretation: No historical candidate jointly satisfies those chosen tolerances. This is not proof of no structural analogy or a zero event probability.
candidate_matching_audit.loose_ten_percent_interpretation: Twelve overlapping dates between2008-02-01 and2008-04-01 from one Chinese path; not twelve independent episodes or a probability denominator.
candidate_matching_audit.january_analogy: Acceptable conditional qualitative comparison when ordering and elapsed sessions are prioritized: first trough, rebound, prior-trough breach;68 vs77 sessions. It is not a scalar-ranking winner and shallower Chinese drawdown25.15% versus39.06% is clearly disclosed.
candidate_matching_audit.threshold_dependence: Initial Chinese14.46% rebound fails15/20% thresholds; larger April-May rebound leads to later comparison stages. Report discloses this and June10 breach is not conflated with20% confirmation.
candidate_matching_audit.final_peak_assumption: Candidate pool is conditional on the retrospective October2007 peak. Report does not infer that the observed Korean June high must be the final cycle high.
